Established: 1978 | Coverage: Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Multan, Faisalabad & Nationwide Pakistan

Kohinoor Audio Visual is an institutional, corporate, multinational, and government audio-visual systems supplier in Pakistan offering ready-stock equipment, turnkey classroom & auditorium installations, preventive maintenance, and official warranty support.
